title: Error response
description: Body of every 4xx and 5xx response from /api/v1 (DEC-08). See the error code table in docs/api/README.md.

code.description: Machine-readable code. Agents treat unknown codes by HTTP status.

message.description: Human-readable message. Never contains internals or secrets.

request_id.description: Same value as the X-Request-Id response header.

details.description: Only on validation_failed: one entry per rejected field.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the rejected value.
